subtitle: Sovereign Intelligence — Connected Paths & Talent Navigation
changes: Added optional collapsible Path Navigator to find official talents by name or node ID and center the chosen node without modifying the original tree layout.
Introduced source-aware upstream and downstream route highlighting using Blizzard-returned link references, always labeled as advisory rather than confirmed game unlock prerequisites.
Expanded convenient talent briefing with current planned ranks, source IDs, and rank description when returned by Blizzard.
Added FIT TREE and CLEAR FOCUS controls for quicker recovery and exploration, preserving existing drag-to-pan and wheel zoom.
Preserved all original point allocation, saved builds, undo/redo, character data, media libraries, existing Ascendant View and account connections.
